svg.title: Phase 04: Dashboard v3, copy to chat. 24–30 Jul 2026 · fixes 17–22. Four tabs and a detail panel. The live bridge to Claude had never been connected, so copying a prompt became the design. Why: “A page with no write access is one you can trust, and nothing on it depends on a runtime feature.”
